questions.cardText:
[Food Science] How are oranges in fruit cups prepared so that they don’t have the white pith or skins?
A. By peeling and soaking the oranges in a chemical solution
B. By using high-pressure steam to blast them away
C. By using equipment that mechanically removes them in large batches
Answer: A. The chemical solution works by breaking down the pectin, which is a structural carbohydrate found in the cell walls of plants.
questions.de: Worin werden die geschälten Orangenspalten für Fruchtbecher aus der Dose eingeweicht, um die weiße Haut und die Segmenthäute zu entfernen?
questions.en: In what are the peeled orange segments for canned fruit cups soaked to strip away their white pith and segment skins?
questions.answerDe: Ein Chemikalienbad: erst Säure, dann Natronlauge
questions.answerEn: A chemical bath: acid, then caustic soda (lye)

timeline.labelEn: US patent 4,139,651 describes the conventional acid-then-caustic-soda bath for stripping mandarin segment membranes
timeline.labelDe: Das US-Patent 4.139.651 beschreibt das übliche Bad aus Säure und dann Natronlauge zum Entfernen der Häute von Mandarinenspalten

source.title: US4139651A - Method of removing citrus-fruit-pulp-segment membranes

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed: the conventional canning process soaks segments in sulphuric or hydrochloric acid (~40 min), rinses, then soaks them in caustic soda (~20 min) (US4139651A, 1979). The card's pectin explanation is not stated by that source; the answer is phrased as the acid/alkali bath. Fruit-cup oranges are usually mandarin segments.

questions.cardText:
[Computer Science] What is the term for an algorithmic structure that mimics the signaling mechanism of the human brain?
A. Artificial intelligence
B. Blockchain
C. Neural network
Answer: C.
questions.de: Wie nennt man ein Rechenmodell aus verbundenen künstlichen Neuronen, das den Netzen signalübertragender Nervenzellen im Gehirn nachempfunden ist?
questions.en: What is the term for a computational model, inspired by the brain's networks of signalling neurons, made of connected artificial neurons?

timeline.labelEn: Warren McCulloch and Walter Pitts publish the first mathematical model of a neural network
timeline.labelDe: Warren McCulloch und Walter Pitts veröffentlichen das erste mathematische Modell eines neuronalen Netzes
